Job Description

GP2Oz Ltd is a leading GP recruitment agency, specialising in placing UK/Irish/NZ/Sth African trained GPs in Australia. With a focus on providing high-quality and suitably qualified applicants to communities across the country, we are currently seeking a skilled and dedicated General Practitioner to join a practice in Bunbury, West Australia. As a General Practitioner in Bunbury, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive and holistic healthcare services to patients of all ages. This includes conducting medical assessments, diagnosing and treating illnesses, prescribing medication, and providing ongoing care and support to patients. Key responsibilities: Conducting consultations with patients to assess their medical needs and concerns Diagnosing and treating a wide range of acute and chronic illnesses Prescribing medication and providing ongoing management for patients with chronic conditions Referring patients to specialists or other healthcare professionals when necessary Maintaining accurate and up-to-date patient records Participating in regular team meetings and case discussions Keeping up-to-date with the latest medical research and developments Adhering to all relevant medical regulations and guidelines Providing support and guidance to other healthcare professionals, such as nurses and allied health workers Contributing to the overall success and growth of the practice through quality patient care and positive patient outcomes. Requirements: A specialist general practice qualification from the UK/Ireland/NZ or Sth Africa Minimum of 1 year of experience working as a specialist General Practitioner Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team Strong diagnostic and decision-making skills Knowledge of current medical practices and regulations Passion for providing high-quality healthcare services to patients. This is a full-time position with a competitive remuneration package and the opportunity for professional development and developing your clinical skills. The successful candidate will also have access to a supportive and collaborative work environment, state-of-the-art facilities, and a diverse patient population. If you are a dedicated and skilled General Practitioner looking for a fulfilling and rewarding career opportunity, we encourage you to apply for this position.
